text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy, I spotted Biwa Hayahide looking pale.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I can't quite say I'm totally fine.
My head hurts a little...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: At first, I thought atmospheric pressure might be the cause and looked into it, but there have been no major changes in the past few days...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The symptoms are lethargy and periodic pain. It's likely a migraine, but head conditions are easily overlooked, so...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Just to be extra thorough, I've been researching
symptom examples of other illnesses.
Though the more I think about it, the more my head...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, I suppose so. I did read an article saying
it's good to let your nerves rest, but..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Tch... Ngh... I still can't settle down after all.
Biwa Hayahide seems to be troubled by a headache...
